description: Public relationship overlay. Canonical nodes are defined by the existing asset graph; assets are optional display hints keyed by canonical ID. Suggested relationships are never identity joins.

statuses.verified: Public evidence URL required; identifies an evidence-backed relationship
statuses.recorded: Explicit public source pointer, not proof of live deployment or external availability
statuses.suggested: Unconfirmed candidate; must not join product identities

format.assets: Optional {id, label} for an existing public node
format.relationships: {from, to, type, status, provenance, evidence_url?}; from/to must be existing public node IDs

public_policy: No private records, credentials, unpublished prompts, GPT editor URLs or inferred health claims.
